info.title: Fantomas is an opinionated source code formatter for F#.
info.description:
This library aims at formatting F# source files based on a given configuration.
Fantomas will ensure correct indentation and consistent spacing between elements in the source files.
Some common use cases include:
(1) Reformatting a code base to conform a universal page width
(2) Converting legacy code from verbose syntax to light syntax
(3) Formatting auto-generated F# signatures.

options.name: --check
options.description:
Report which files need formatting and write nothing.
Exits 0 when every file is already formatted, 99 when some
file needs formatting, and 1 when an error occurred.

options.name: --out
options.description:
Write the result to this file or folder instead of formatting
in place. Takes a single input path.

options.name: --force
options.description:
Write the output even when it is not valid F# code.
For debugging purposes only.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Print the line count and the time taken for every file.

options.name: --json
options.description:
Report what the run did as one JSON document on standard out,
naming every file and positioning what went wrong. The usual
messages are not printed; warnings go to standard error.

options.name: --daemon
options.description:
Run an LSP-like server that editor tooling can talk to.
Takes no other flags or paths, apart from --verbosity.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description:
How much to print: normal or detailed. Defaults to normal.
n and d are accepted as well.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Display this menu and exit
Paths:
A path is a folder, which is searched recursively, or a file ending in .fs, .fsi,
.fsx, .ml or .mli. Formatting settings are read from .editorconfig, and files
matched by .fantomasignore in the current folder are skipped.
